result.title: Efficient LLM Adaptation with Forward-Only Passes
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference serving is undergoing rapid growth and large-scale deployment, motivating us to rethink how the inference process itself can be leveraged to enable efficient task-specific LLM adaptation. In this paper, we propose a forward-only approach for efficient LLM adaptation with forward-only passes in LLM inference serving. We exploit the angle concentration of activations induced by each singular value decomposition (SVD) component to measure its contribution-dispersed or concentrated-to the angle concentration of the hidden states. Based on this, our forward-only search then efficiently identifies the weight matrix with the highest dispersion that merits rank reduction. We then selectively remove the higher-order components and retain the lower-order components in SVD. Empirical results across diverse datasets demonstrate the competitive accuracy of our forward-only approach, while theoretical analysis shows lower peak memory and greater speedup than the gradient-based approach and greater speedup than the exhaustive search approach. The experiments further present the robustness and generalization of our forward-only approach to various LLMs with up to 57B parameters. The code is included in the supplementary material.

AI.brief_summary: 提出仅前向的 LLM 适配方法：用每个 SVD 分量引起的激活角度集中度衡量其对隐藏状态的贡献是分散还是集中，据此搜索最值得降秩的权重矩阵，并选择性地移除高阶分量、保留低阶分量，从而免梯度、低峰值显存地完成适配。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以激活几何（角度集中度）免梯度地刻画各 SVD 分量对隐藏状态的贡献，可能为 LVR 中 latent 方向的贡献分配与训练-free 状态成分筛选提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
